provenance: Selected numerical values from successful original-source Actions stdout; complete numerical results and original aggregate cohort are retained in the cited run artifacts. Re-execution is reproducibility, not a biological replicate.
metadata_resolution_note: Seven excluded surveys have forage plant Prunus spp. versus nectar Prunus avium. Dates and locations agree. This is a taxonomic-resolution mismatch, not evidence of incompatible plant samples. The frozen exact-label primary analysis does not silently upgrade a genus-level behavior record to species identity.

pooled.role: single prespecified primary in an exploratory secondary analysis

interpretation: Primary wind-by-reward interaction not supported, not an equivalence finding. Secondary adjusted wind association is negative in pooled and Brighton estimates but not clearly reproduced in Edinburgh; not a causal effect or statistical test of city differences.
response: log1p(survey mean observed probes per 60 seconds)
wind: ordinal Beaufort, within-plant centered, not m/s
reward: sampled potential nectar J per flower, log1p and within-plant centered/SD-scaled, not observed intake
